brand.notes: Singer Pakistan AC — brand now under Waves Corporation Ltd (ex-Waves Singer Pakistan Ltd, PSX). PK AC lines: Invertor/DC Inverter SAC-12NV-SF, SAC-18NV-SF, SAC-18K INV. 'Green Inverter' is a Singer Bangladesh product (roadmap note corrected) — BD models (SAS*, SASLV*, EH03/E101 videos) kept only as low-confidence claims, never promoted. Data basis: Forever Tech video episodes (PK-oriented secondary) + Fully5world PK compilation for 8 high codes; no official PK fault table or service manual exists. Live singer.com.pk domains are not official. See docs/sources/singer.md.
